description: Record COMPLETED exercise(s) into the athlete's STRUGGL ledger (with duplicate-write protection, PR tracking, 17-muscle volume accounting, and automatic read-only card sync in the STRUGGL app). Prefer passing `sessions: [...]` + `debrief_summary` in a single batch call for a whole session.

date.description: Workout date YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to today; acts as default date for `sessions`).

debrief_summary.description: Concise coaching takeaways shown under the workout card in the athlete's STRUGGL app connector feed.

exercise.description: Exercise name when logging a single exercise (omit when using `sessions`).

rpe.description: Session RPE (1–10). When omitted in STRUGGL's stateful ledger, inferred deterministically from the athlete's rolling 30-day e1RM capacity envelope.

sessions.description: Batch of completed exercises to log in one atomic call (preferred over N separate calls).

weight_kg.description: External load in kg (added load for pull-ups/dips/chin-ups).

name: log_workout
